rounds.outcome: G6 (index-led) selected 2 to 1, the blinded tiebreak siding with judge two. Round two not convergent.

selectedSpine: G6 index-led: the section opens on its contents of every story; scroll opens each story out of the contents and folds it back before the next.

adopted: Opacity-only passages: the story fades, the contents arrives, the mark steps one row, the next story arrives; no heading travel or scaling of live text (judge two and tiebreak).
State is a pure function of position read from the panel's computed sticky top; no lock, no hysteresis; full first and last holds; a full story holds 1.5x (round one and two lessons).
Server-rendered plan: data-story-rests and --story-units come from the same storyPlan the page reads; nothing hidden in server markup; aria-hidden and inert set on mount.
Live region announces 'Story n of N. heading' only; aria-disabled at the ends.
Per-part budgets, exact-substring quote, no em dash and no 'not X, but Y' enforced in src/test/leadership-stories.test.ts.
Scene: engraver's pantograph, recomposed square, framed with a brass hairline and an ink mat beside the words; take 0 of 4 chosen for a coherent linkage and the clearest blade of light.

Copy: round-one judges' preferred situation and 'A post like that now takes under an hour.'; quote 'I've learnt to push through basic barriers I didn't realise I could' carries the way in; straight marks to match the six.
No-JS: contents as links, then every story in order.
declined: Counter as a contents button (an extra control; the contents rows and arrows already reach every story).
Raising the counter from 9px to 13px (it would change the six's frame; qa:type-system passes it today).
Amber on 'under an hour' (amber means what moved since yesterday; decoration risk).
A gliding mint mark between rows (the mark steps; the register under the arrows glides).

feasibility: Measured on the built site: at 1440x900 and 390x844 the six keep today's heading tops, heights, stage bottom and controls on both pages; story one and the contents fit their stage at 1440x900, 390x844, 1280x600, 720x450, 1536x730 and 320x568; on /new-age-leadership the arrows clear the action bar at every size.

revisions.outcome: Blocked by the accessibility veto before human review; revised as r2.

changes: Focus moves to the opened story heading in the same paint that opens it, before the contents goes inert.
From the contents, Next opens the marked story; from an open story it opens the next.
The r5 generator carries the 2026-09-26 no-blur .scroll-reveal correction; the generated file equals main outside the r6 layer.
A landscape phone (max-height 430px) reads the section as a document; the stage clips instead of scrolling.
Contents rows are at least 44px; the focus ring is inset and tinted; the plate figure is aria-hidden.

Copy: 'and they keep building it around what they do and where they get stuck'; the quote is the founder's whole sentence "It's helping me be seen by my customers."; the heading keeps the source's hedge, 'posted about once a month'.
Story text 16px on a phone and 14px on short screens; the probe checks for a lone last word at every resting state; the story step on short screens is at least 26svh.
declined: Story one's heading stays smaller than the six's: a full story needs room for four parts and a plate in one stage.
The quote stays stored as text, guarded by an exact-substring test, rather than importing testimonials.ts into the homepage bundle.
Pinned travel stays about 40% longer than today, bounded at 400svh.

veto: access: contents row 07 cut at 1024x768 on /new-age-leadership, the homepage arrows below the fold at 1024x700, the six quotes cut by the bar reserve at laptop sizes

revisions.outcome: Blocked by the accessibility veto before human review; revised as r3.

changes: The contents and a full story lie over the stage and fit themselves to it (--fit, floor 0.75); the six size the stage as today and it never shrinks to clip a line; at 320x568 the stage grows to hold story one.
The arrows are lifted clear of the action bar, the cookie notice or the fold by measurement: spare room first, then the stage's empty height (never below what it holds), then the air above the label.
One whole state at a time chosen by position, changed by a short timed fade (out 0.16s, then in 0.24s); immediate with reduced motion. Shorter passages and a 22svh unit on phones and short screens.
Arrows decide from position (storyTargets); disabled arrows do nothing; pinTop cached; late focus hand-offs dropped; controls are a labelled group.
Story one's heading about 50px at 1440x900; quote beside the plate; 'A post' held together; what happened in three short sentences ('It fits around what they do and where they get stuck.').
Focus rings outside the row and heading; no row marked current in document mode; document-mode links land clear of the masthead.
revisions.evidence: A 31-size sweep on both pages finds no new issue against today's build (viewport-sweep.json); the six are identical at 1440x900 and 390x844 on both pages and move only where today puts the arrows under the bar or fold, cuts a quote, or at 320x568.

veto: access: under reduced motion the fit and lift read sizes mid transition; arrows below the fold at 1024x700 and 1100x700, contents cut at 320x568 and 360x640

revisions.outcome: Blocked by the accessibility veto before human review; revised as r4.

changes: The panel carries is-measuring while the script measures, switching transitions off, so reduced motion measures as full motion does.
Where the contents cannot fit at the floor it keeps the largest type that takes no more room; row text never below 13px; the stage grows (small phones).
The contents and a full story keep 14px of air above the arrows, as the six do.

The contents no longer returns between stories; Previous on the first story goes back to it. Each story holds at least a quarter of the screen (30svh desktop, 27svh phone, 25svh short screen); travel within about a tenth of today's.
The lift is measured against the pinned panel's small-viewport foot; attributes written only when they change; no double announcement.
Copy: 'now posts most days'; 'a post' held together; balanced contents rows; story one's heading at the six's size in document mode.
revisions.synthesisChange: Declined the in-between contents adopted in round one (the mark stepping between stories). Round three's motion and buyer judges independently found it too brief to read as a place and a lengthening of the scroll; the opening contents, its links, the counter and Previous back to the contents keep the index-led idea.
revisions.evidence: Sweeps on both pages, 31 sizes in full motion and 18 with reduced motion, find no issue today's build does not have (viewport-sweep.json, viewport-sweep-reduced.json).

veto: access: Tabbing into the section before it pinned left the arrows wholly under the action bar on /new-age-leadership (WCAG 2.2, 2.4.11)

revisions.outcome: Blocked by the accessibility veto before human review; revised as r5.

changes: Keyboard focus entering the section before it pins moves the page at once to the focused state's rest, pinned, arrows clear; the probe gains a Tab check with a planted negative control.
On a small touch screen under both the action bar and the cookie notice, contents rows give up height (not below 32px) so the arrows clear.
The lift starts only on a real overlap; a resize that changes no input skips re-measuring; quick arrow presses each count; focus moves to the opening story if the contents goes inert under it.
Story one holds twice a one-line story; slightly larger words beside a smaller plate; about 45px heading on an upright tablet; the six's heading size as a document; 'a research' held together.
No current mark in the contents; the controls keep main's 'benefit' wording until the six are sourced; the quote test also guards the testimonial's publishability and role.
revisions.evidence: Tab journeys on both pages at six sizes, with and without motion and the cookie notice: no hidden focus stop. Sweeps (31 sizes full motion, 19 reduced) find no issue today's build does not have; the six are identical at 1440x900 and 390x844.
